title: Proof-Carrying Contracts: Commitments AI Agents Cannot Break
abstract: arXiv:2610.28484v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents increasingly act on behalf of people or other agents, purchasing services, exchanging information and delegating work. What an agent must respect is written in instructions, policies or agreements, but text alone cannot make it comply. It may make mistakes, be redirected by what it reads, or pursue different interests. For an economy of such agents to function, parties need agreements they can rely on without inspecting or trusting one another's agents. We introduce Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2), a framework for making agreed constraints enforceable throughout an agent's interactions with a system. Before a requested operation can run, the agent must supply a machine-checkable proof that it preserves the agreed constraints in every case allowed by its model. translated_title: 证明携带合约：AI智能体无法违背的承诺
translated_abstract: AI智能体越来越多地代表人类或其他智能体行事——购买服务、交换信息、委托工作。智能体必须遵守的内容被写在指令、政策或协议中，但仅凭文本无法保证其合规。智能体可能犯错，可能被它读到的内容误导，或者追求不同的利益。要使这样的智能体经济体系正常运转，各方需要无需检查或信任彼此的智能体就能依赖的协议。我们提出了证明携带合约（Proof-Carrying Contracts，PC2），这是一个使约定约束在智能体与系统的整个交互过程中可强制执行的框架。在请求的操作运行之前，智能体必须提供机器可验证的证明，表明在其模型允许的每一种情况下都能保持约定的约束。一个名为Airlock的执行系统负责检查该证明并控制对操作的访问。各参与方指定需要保持的条件，而智能体提供……
tldr: 提出了证明携带合约（PC2）框架，要求AI智能体在执行操作前必须提供机器可验证的证明以确保遵守约定的约束，并由Airlock执行系统验证证明和控制访问，从而在无需相互信任的智能体经济中实现可强制执行的协议。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2), a framework requiring AI agents to provide machine-checkable proofs that their operations preserve agreed constraints, with an execution system called Airlock verifying proofs and controlling access, enabling enforceable agreements in an agent economy without requiring mutual trust.
